_comment: Mutation testing measures whether the suite's assertions actually bite: coverage says a line ran, not that its effect was checked. Scoped to the pure domain modules every command depends on — they are deterministic text transformations, so a surviving mutant is a real assertion gap rather than flakiness. Run with `npm run test:mutation`.
_thresholdsComment: low is the measured baseline, not an aspiration — it only rises. break stays null: this is an on-demand sensor, and a full run takes minutes, so it does not gate CI.
